facts.event: Elise 被卫兵带进父亲 Liran 的昏暗寝殿，她颤身行礼，先称 Tilde 为“Queen Tilde”，再唤父亲“My King”“Father-hyem”
facts.relation: Elise 是 Liran 与 Isabella 的女儿；Tilde 曾是她的情人，如今是 Liran 的王后、她的继母
facts.anchor: In her father’s dark chamber, Tilde stood like a sentinel, her hair loose, her hands empty.

facts.event: Liran 认不出女儿，反问“Who is that?”，Elise 只好自报“I am your daughter … Princess Elise. Isabella’s child.”
facts.relation: 父女：Liran 已遗忘女儿 Elise（不是第一次忘）
facts.anchor: ‘Who is that?’ He looked at her at last, and there was no recognition in the sea blue of his eyes.

facts.event: Liran 把手按在 Tilde 腹部宣示占有，Tilde 微微一颤、厌恶地绷紧身体却仍由着他
facts.relation: 夫妻：Liran 与怀孕的 Tilde；Elise 由此对 Tilde 生出一丝怜悯
facts.anchor: then put a possessive hand over her belly. She flinched, slightly, but let him, holding herself tense with disgust

facts.event: Elise 求 Tilde 认她，Tilde 却低声否认“She is no one. We do not know her.”，Liran 像狗一样跟着复述
facts.relation: 情人反目：Tilde 当众否认与 Elise 的关系
facts.anchor: ‘No,’ Tilde whispered, and Elise felt the word like ice in her breast.

facts.event: Elise 想通真相：Tilde 除 Merogian 魔法外还用了她家族 Cynghal 的血魔法，对当年把魔法教给 Alar 的 Liran 下了毒
facts.relation: Tilde 是下毒者/篡位者；受害者是她的丈夫 Liran
facts.anchor: the blood magic too of Cynghal, of Elise’s family. And she had used it on the man who had first taught it to Alar.

facts.event: Tilde 诬称众子皆已逃亡背叛，Elise 冲上前喊“No!”，被 Tilde 的卫兵扭住双臂按倒在地
facts.relation: 继母女对立；卫兵听命于 Tilde 而非国王
facts.anchor: running forward, but Tilde’s guards took hold of her, twisting her arms behind her and forcing her to her knees

facts.event: Tilde 说“It is not love that will save us … It is power.”，给 Elise 一条“生路”：卫兵押她去港口任选一条船远走
facts.relation: 旧情人以“仁慈”为名放逐 Elise
facts.anchor: my guards will take you far from the castle, to the harbour’s edge

facts.event: Tilde 说完“Freedom is my last gift to you … Take it, Princess, and run.”，Elise 后脑即遭重击，眼前先白后黑
facts.relation: Tilde 的“馈赠”实为击昏押走
facts.anchor: Elise felt the sharp pain to the back of her head.
